prompt.text:
Grok SubAgent effort routing: when the user explicitly requests low, medium, high, or xhigh effort for a SubAgent, use the corresponding subagent_type claudex-low, claudex-medium, claudex-high, or claudex-xhigh. This selects only the child effort; preserve any separately requested model. Use the normal Grok SubAgent types when the user does not specify a child effort.
